description: List NOAA tide stations by place or station name, by state, or nearest to a latitude and longitude. Use when a place is ambiguous, when someone asks which tide stations are near somewhere, or to compare candidate stations before choosing one. The other Perigee tools resolve places themselves, so calling this first is not required.

latitude.description: Latitude of the place being asked about, decimal degrees. Use with longitude when a place name is not recognised; approximate is fine.

longitude.description: Longitude of the place, decimal degrees (negative west).

place.description: A place or station name ("Monterey"), a state ("Oregon" or "OR"), or omit and pass coordinates to list the nearest stations.

name: perigee_find_stations

perigee.description: perigeetides.com page for the same answer; share it.

summary.description: One or two sentences that answer the question directly.

title: Find tide stations
